allow_instructions: Prioritize lean-ctx and fetch MCP. Avoid heavy terminal outputs.
block_instructions: git commit, checkout, reset --hard, clean -f, and branch -D require approval; git push --force and git push -f stay blocked unless the user asks for them.
Do not read or write .env files, credentials, secrets/, private keys, or cloud credential paths.
Do not dump environment variables (env, printenv); they carry tokens.

Do not write to credential, shell-startup, or tool-config dotfiles and dot-directories under the home directory (e.g. ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, ~/.config, ~/.bashrc, ~/.zshrc, ~/.gitconfig, ~/.claude/settings*.json, ~/.claude/hooks); ~/.claude/projects/-workspace/memory is the only exception.
Do not call the codebase-memory-mcp delete_project tool.
Do not run terraform apply, destroy, import, state mv, state rm, or force-unlock.
Do not run aws CLI delete-* or put-* subcommands.
Do not read .terraform/, node_modules/, apm_modules/, lambda/outputs/, site/, or *.lock files.
